title: Where's the Respect?
overview: "Where’s the Respect?" is a track written, composed, and produced by Ali Boubacar Bonkano, featuring vocals by Bima Bama. Delivered as a raw, personal narrative from Bama’s perspective, the lyrics confront the persistent jealousy and scrutiny Bonkano faces within the fashion industry. By centering the recurring question, "Where's the respect?", the track critiques a competitive environment while asserting Bonkano’s dominance and refusal to be derailed. Ultimately, the song serves as a defiant declaration of focus, confirming that he will continue to advance his craft and legacy, indifferent to the negative opinions and insecurities of those waiting for his downfall.
